comments.text:
Description:
MySql supports different platforms as mentioned in a table on below link: https://www.mysql.com/support/supportedplatforms/database.html. 
Above page says it supports Ubuntu 20.04 LTS and Ubuntu 22.04 LTS only. 
However https://dev.mysql.com/downloads/mysql/ page has downloads for Ub22.10 and ub23.04 also. 
Can you please confirm which all Ubuntu distributions are officially supported?

How to repeat:
-

Hello Nayana,

Thank you for the feedback.

Long Term Support releases of e.g. Ubuntu are indeed listed in the Supported Platforms list at https://www.mysql.com/support/supportedplatforms/database.html

In addition, as a service to the overall community of MySQL users, we may choose to provide binaries for non-LTS versions.

Regards,
Ashwini Patil
